meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分类和验证 issue 与 PR，生成 agent 可用简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要手动分类和验证 GitHub issue 与外部 PR
copy.tagline_en: Automatically categorize and verify issues and PRs, generate agent-ready briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often manually categorize and verify GitHub issues and external PRs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你分类和推进 GitHub 议题或外部 PR。它会先展示待处理项，然后按你的指令执行分类、验证、追问，最后打上标签、写摘要或关闭。
howto.when: 当你在对话中输入 `/triage` 并描述需求时触发，例如“看看 #42”或“把 #42 移到 ready-for-agent”。

say.text: 帮我看看哪些议题需要我处理。
say.note: Claude 会列出未分类、待评估等议题。
Claude 会直接应用状态并询问是否写摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you categorize and advance GitHub issues or external PRs. It first shows pending items, then follows your instructions to classify, verify, ask follow-ups, and finally apply labels, write summaries, or close.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type `/triage` in the chat and describe what you want, e.g., "Look at #42" or "Move #42 to ready-for-agent".

say_en.text: Show me what issues need my attention.
say_en.note: Claude will list unlabeled, needs-triage, etc.
Claude will apply the state and ask if you want a brief.
